# MH GLOBAL EDUCATION CONSULTANT — Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base & Entity Profile
Website: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in
Contact Email: admissions@mhglobalmedical.in
Canonical Domain: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in

## Section 1: Institutional Profile & E-E-A-T
MH GLOBAL EDUCATION CONSULTANT is an international medical education consultancy and student facilitation platform headquartered in New Delhi, India, with dedicated on-ground coordinator desks across major academic cities in Uzbekistan (Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, and Andijan). The consultancy specializes exclusively in transparent, NMC-compliant 6-year General Medicine (MD Physician / MBBS equivalent) admissions for Indian students.

Key Commitments:
1. Direct University Payments: Tuition and official hostel fees are paid directly to the university's official bank account.
2. Full NMC FMGL 2021 Alignment: Every university counseled strictly fulfills the 54-month coursework requirement, 12-month in-house hospital internship requirement, 100% English medium instruction, and host country practice registration.
3. On-Ground Student Care: Dedicated Indian wardens and regional coordinators supervise hostel allotments, Indian mess catering, SIM card registration, OVIR residency permits, and emergency health assistance.

## Section 2: Detailed University Fee Structure & Statistics (2026-2027)
Conversion Benchmark: 1 USD ≈ ₹84.50 INR.

1. Tashkent Medical Academy (TMA)
- City: Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Type: State Government Medical Academy (Established 1919)
- Academic Duration: 6 Years (54 Months Course + 12 Months Hospital Internship)
- Medium: 100% English Medium
- Annual Tuition: $3,900 USD (~₹3.30 Lakhs INR)
- Annual Hostel: $700 USD (~₹59,000 INR)
- Indian Mess: ~$1,000 to $1,100 USD / year (~₹84,500 to ₹93,000 INR)
- Total 6-Year Estimate: ~$25,000 – $28,000 USD (₹21.1 Lakhs – ₹23.7 Lakhs INR)
- Clinical Affiliations: 3,500+ beds in 8 Republican Specialized Centers.
- URL: https://www.mhglobalmedical.in/universities/uzbekistan/tashkent-medical-academy

## Section 3: NMC FMGL 2021 Regulatory Compliance Breakdown
For Indian students returning to India to practice medicine, the National Medical Commission (NMC) Foreign Medical Graduate Licentiate (FMGL) Regulations 2021 stipulate:
1. Course Length: Minimum 54 months of academic study. Uzbekistan provides 60 months of formal medical instruction, exceeding this requirement.
2. Internship: Mandatory 12-month clerkship in the host country's hospital in the same university. Uzbekistan medical degrees award the final qualification only after the 6th-year hospital internship.
3. Language: Entire academic course and examination must be in English.
4. Host Country License: Graduating students receive state license and registration privileges in Uzbekistan.
5. NEET-UG: Indian citizens must qualify NEET-UG prior to departure; score is valid for 3 years.
6. Screening in India: Graduates appear for the National Exit Test (NExT Step 1), complete 1 year of CRMI internship in India, and clear NExT Step 2 for permanent medical council registration.

## Section 4: Frequently Asked Questions & Answers
Q: How much does MBBS in Uzbekistan cost in Indian Rupees?
A: The total 6-year package across government medical universities ranges from ₹20 Lakhs to ₹26 Lakhs INR ($24,000 to $31,000 USD), including tuition fees ($3,200–$3,900/year), university hostel ($500–$700/year), and Indian mess food ($1,000–$1,100/year).

Q: Is Indian food available in Uzbekistan?
A: Yes. All major medical universities with Indian students maintain dedicated Indian messes run by Indian cooks serving vegetarian and halal non-vegetarian food 3 times daily.

Q: How long is the flight from India to Tashkent?
A: Direct flights from Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) in New Delhi to Tashkent (TAS) take approximately 3 hours via Uzbekistan Airways and IndiGo.
